question: Can a named Panay river fish study provide a trustworthy, site-aware species source for regional coverage?

findings.sourceType: peer-reviewed freshwater fish composition research note; repository metadata and abstract reviewed
findings.waterbodyAsReported: Tigum River, Iloilo, Panay Island; repository metadata also indexes Maasin, Cabatuan and Santa Barbara.
findings.access: West Visayas State University repository record, abstract and indexed taxonomic terms are accessible. The repository full-text link redirects to a login/request-copy workflow. The DOST Philippine Journal of Science PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403 during review. No document request or external contact was submitted.
findings.interpretation: This is a useful historical, named-river source lead for freshwater fish coverage. The abstract reports ten species, but the repository's indexed terms expose only eight taxonomic entries, including Platycephalus at genus level. The complete identity list and any site-by-taxon mapping cannot be reconstructed from the repository abstract alone. The reported composition percentages describe the study sample, not present abundance in the river.

evidenceBoundary: Sampling occurred in 2015-2016; this source does not establish present-day presence, abundance, range or population trend.
The full ten-name checklist, taxonomic determinations and site-by-taxon crosswalk were not reviewed.
No coordinates or reach-level species records were added.
No current species distribution, diet, bait response, catchability, safety or legal-access assertion was made.
Article and table reuse terms are unverified; public-app reproduction is not approved.

disposition.reason: The article full text could not be accessed in this review; repository metadata and abstract provide a source lead but do not support a complete, site-specific species checklist.

nextAction: Obtain the full article through an authorized accessible copy. Verify the ten scientific names, sampling methods and dates, site/reach mapping, voucher or specimen accessions, taxonomic references and reuse terms before creating any species or occurrence records.

sources.supports: WVSU repository citation, abstract, field period, reported total, indexed taxonomic terms and linked geographic metadata.
